## Modules

- [AshPostgres.Extensions.ImmutableRaiseError](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Extensions.ImmutableRaiseError.md): An extension that installs an immutable version of ash_raise_error.
- [AshPostgres.Igniter](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Igniter.md): Codemods and utilities for working with AshPostgres & Igniter
- [AshPostgres.MigrationCompileCache](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.MigrationCompileCache.md): A cache for the compiled migrations.
- [AshPostgres.Functions.Binding](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.Binding.md): Refers to the current table binding.

- [AshPostgres.Functions.PostgresIn](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.PostgresIn.md): Generates a native SQL `IN (...)` clause instead of the default `= ANY(...)` array syntax.
- [AshPostgres.Functions.VectorL2Distance](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.VectorL2Distance.md): Maps to the vector l2 distance operator. Requires `vector` extension to be installed.

- AshPostgres
  - [AshPostgres](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.md): The AshPostgres extension gives you tools to map a resource to a postgres database table.
  - [AshPostgres.DataLayer](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.DataLayer.md): A postgres data layer that leverages Ecto's postgres capabilities.

  - [AshPostgres.Repo](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Repo.md): Resources that use `AshPostgres.DataLayer` use a `Repo` to access the database.

- Utilities
  - [AshPostgres.ManualRelationship](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.ManualRelationship.md): A behavior for postgres-specific manual relationship functionality

- Introspection
  - [AshPostgres.CheckConstraint](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.CheckConstraint.md): Represents a configured check constraint on the table backing a resource
  - [AshPostgres.CustomExtension](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.CustomExtension.md): A custom extension implementation.

  - [AshPostgres.CustomIndex](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.CustomIndex.md): Represents a custom index on the table backing a resource
  - [AshPostgres.DataLayer.Info](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.DataLayer.Info.md): Introspection functions for 
  - [AshPostgres.Reference](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Reference.md): Represents the configuration of a reference (i.e foreign key).
  - [AshPostgres.Statement](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Statement.md): Represents a custom statement to be run in generated migrations

- Types
  - [AshPostgres.Ltree](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Ltree.md): Ash Type for [postgres `ltree`](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ltree.html),
a hierarchical tree-like data type.
  - [AshPostgres.Timestamptz](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Timestamptz.md): Implements the PostgresSQL [timestamptz](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-datetime.html) (aka `timestamp with time zone`) type.
  - [AshPostgres.TimestamptzUsec](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.TimestamptzUsec.md): Implements the PostgresSQL [timestamptz](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-datetime.html) (aka `timestamp with time zone`) type with nanosecond precision.
  - [AshPostgres.Tsquery](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Tsquery.md): A thin wrapper around `:string` for working with tsquery types in calculations.
  - [AshPostgres.Tsvector](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Tsvector.md): A type for representing postgres' tsvectors.
  - [AshPostgres.Type](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Type.md): Postgres specific callbacks for `Ash.Type`.

- Extensions
  - [AshPostgres.Extensions.Vector](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Extensions.Vector.md): An extension that adds support for the `vector` type.

- Custom Aggregates
  - [AshPostgres.CustomAggregate](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.CustomAggregate.md): A custom aggregate implementation for ecto.

- Postgres Migrations
  - [AshPostgres.Migration](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Migration.md): Utilities for use in migrations
  - [EctoMigrationDefault](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/EctoMigrationDefault.md): Allows configuring how values are translated to default values in migrations.

- Expressions
  - [AshPostgres.Functions.ILike](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.ILike.md): Maps to the builtin postgres function `ilike`.

  - [AshPostgres.Functions.Like](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.Like.md): Maps to the builtin postgres function `like`.

  - [AshPostgres.Functions.TrigramSimilarity](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.TrigramSimilarity.md): Maps to the builtin postgres trigram similarity function. Requires `pgtrgm` extension to be installed.
  - [AshPostgres.Functions.VectorCosineDistance](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/AshPostgres.Functions.VectorCosineDistance.md): Maps to the vector cosine distance operator. Requires `vector` extension to be installed.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_postgres.create](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.Create.md): Create the storage for repos in all resources for the given (or configured) domains.
- [mix ash_postgres.drop](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.Drop.md): Drop the storage for the given repository.
- [mix ash_postgres.gen.resources](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.Gen.Resources.md): Generates resources based on a database schema
- [mix ash_postgres.generate_migrations](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.GenerateMigrations.md): Generates migrations, and stores a snapshot of your resources.
- [mix ash_postgres.install](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.Install.md): Installs AshPostgres. Should be run with `mix igniter.install ash_postgres`
- [mix ash_postgres.migrate](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.Migrate.md): Runs the pending migrations for the given repository.
- [mix ash_postgres.rollback](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.Rollback.md): Reverts applied migrations in the given repository.
Migrations are expected at "priv/YOUR_REPO/migrations" directory
of the current application but it can be configured by specifying
the `:priv` key under the repository configuration.
Runs the latest applied migration by default. To roll back to
a version number, supply `--to version_number`. To roll back a
specific number of times, use `--step n`. To undo all applied
migrations, provide `--all`.
- [mix ash_postgres.setup_vector](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.SetupVector.md): Sets up pgvector for AshPostgres
- [mix ash_postgres.squash_snapshots](https://ash-postgres.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPostgres.SquashSnapshots.md): Cleans snapshots folder, leaving only one snapshot per resource.
